scope: Cached native-output accuracy and coverage audit, not inference or a latency measurement. All references are repeated development validation.

sampling_policy.stratum_construction: numpy.array_split of zero-based complete sequential frame indices; sizes differ by at most1
sampling_policy.selection: numpy.default_rng(seed).choice(stratum,size5,replaceFalse), in temporal order; no image or model features used
sampling_policy.weights: N_h/n_h fixed before labels. Ratio metrics from Horvitz-Thompson weighted TP/FP/FN. Approximate95% normal intervals by stratified finite-population variance and delta method, conditional on these two development videos; not patient generalization intervals
sampling_policy.known_failure_frames: Existing29 and12 tip pilot remain diagnostic supplements; do not pool convenience samples into probability-sample estimates unless randomly selected
sampling_policy.partial_review_policy: No overall estimate until all planned sample references are approved. Dense accuracy remains unavailable; unknown-pixel fractions reported separately
